title: Klimt and his Women Gold Coin Set Proof
descriptionPlain: Our Klimt and his Women series, which began in 2012 as a celebration of the 150th anniversary of the Viennese master’s birth, has drawn to a close in 2016. Five superbly crafted coins in five years have each been dedicated to a different Gustav Klimt masterpiece. From classical and allegorical to erotic and mythological, Adele Bloch-Bauer I, Expectation, Judith II and Medicine are proof that the ever-popular Austrian painter succeeded in portraying female beauty like few others. However, no other work of Klimt’s could provide a more fitting climax to the series than his most famous painting, The Kiss. Now that the series is over don’t miss the chance to purchase all five stunning gold coins in one go. In unparalleled Proof quality, these five mini masterpieces come in an attractive collector case.
